about: Ships and yachts: big marine diesels by power, the start, a deep foghorn and a yacht's air horn, the anchor chain out and in, the hull creaking and the bow wave, and the ship's bell.
notes: v3 (vehicle round). Engine layers are 20 s beds cut to loop, played faster or slower by rpm; slot names match core:vehicle's, so a vehicle of this family is heard by them first and by core:vehicle for the rest.

prompts.text: A motor yacht's big marine diesel engines idle at anchor: a deep low throbbing rumble felt through the hull, constant pitch. Recorded on deck. Steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/low.want: the marine diesel at low revs

prompts.text: A ship's big marine diesel engine runs at slow ahead: a deep steady pounding throb and hum, constant pitch. Recorded on deck. Steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/mid.want: the marine diesel at middle revs

prompts.text: A ship's big marine diesel engine runs at cruising speed: a deep loud steady rumble and drone with water rushing along the hull, constant pitch. Recorded on deck. Steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/high.want: the marine diesel at full power

prompts.text: A ship's big marine diesel engine runs at full power: a heavy roaring drone and vibration with water rushing along the hull, constant pitch. Recorded on deck. Steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/start.want: the big diesel starting on air

prompts.text: A ship's big diesel engine starts: a hiss of compressed air, a few heavy slow chugs, and it rumbles into a steady throbbing idle, one start. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A big ship sounds its deep foghorn: a long, loud, low blast over the sea, two separate blasts with long pauses. No music, no voices, quiet background.
A motor yacht's twin air horn sounds a loud bright blast, three separate blasts with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A ship's anchor is dropped: the heavy chain rattles and roars out through the hawse pipe and the anchor splashes into the sea, one drop. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

anchor/raise.want: the windlass hauling the chain in

prompts.text: A ship's anchor is raised: an electric windlass grinds and the heavy chain clanks in link by link, steady, one haul. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

hull/slow.want: the hull creaking and water sloshing at anchor

prompts.text: Aboard a wooden yacht at sea: the hull and timbers creak and groan slowly with the swell and water sloshes against the side, steady. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

hull/fast.want: the bow wave rushing along the hull

prompts.text: The bow of a large ship cuts through the sea: a heavy steady rushing wash of water and foam along the hull, constant. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A ship's brass bell rings, two sharp clangs at a time, four separate rings with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
